Abstract excerpt: Universal multimodal retrieval aims to support diverse instruction-aware retrieval tasks, demanding both efficient corpus-scale matching and fine-grained semantic reasoning. Recent MLLM-based embedding methods typically derive representations from hidden states, while Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning is emerging as a promising strategy for embedding enhancement by encoding intermediate semantic evidence into the representation space.
